verdict.rationale: Secureframe's Comply AI generates suggestions from customer data inside the product. It produces risk scores, treatment plans and justifications from risk descriptions, auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes, drafts SSPs and POA&Ms that reflect real-time compliance data, and extracts answers from vendor documents. These AI features are tied to specific workflows rather than offering broad insights across the user's data, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: general in-product AI insights or analysis across the user's compliance data beyond these workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Leverage auto-generated fixes for infrastructure as code so you can easily copy, paste, and deploy fixes to your cloud environment.
Generate SSPs, POA&Ms, and SPRS scores with AI to reflect real-time compliance data
Leverage Comply AI to automatically extract relevant answers to security review questions from vendor documents like SOC 2 reports and policies.
